question: The body of animals of the phylum Protozoa, such as Paramecium, Amoeba, Euglena, shows ________ grade organisation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**protoplasmic.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Protozoa is a phylum having **unicellular heterotrophs**. It comes under Kingdom Protista.
 
• A protozoan body consists of only a mass of protoplasm, so they are called acellular or non-cellular animals. Grade of organization: **protoplasmic grade of organization**.
 
• **Single-cell performs all the vital activities thus the single cell acts** like a whole body. The body** of protozoa is either naked or covered by a pellicle.**
 
• Protozoa can be divided into four phyla based on their locomotion: **Mastigophora, Sarcodina, Ciliophora, and Sporozoa**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b1149550084fd4e895543d9f40fb390a035a2a2e0b6f723b3f1bed13d404409.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tissue-organ**_​ The organ level of organization is **when two or more tissues work together for a specific function**. For example, **the bladder consists of an inner lining of epithelial tissue, bound by various connective tissues to (smooth) muscle.**
 
• Most organisms have functional parts with five levels: **cells, tissues, organs, organ systems and whole organisms**.
 
• "Cellular organization" is **the defining property in living organisms.**
